The FloPlast screw-on end cap, designed for soil and vent drainage systems, offers a reliable solution for plumbing professionals. Manufactured from robust uPVC, this 110mm grey end cap provides strength and is suitable for high temperature waste discharges. It grants essential access to the soil stack, allowing for straightforward testing and maintenance of the drainage system. The push-fit connection ensures simple installation; using silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate secure jointing. This durable end cap maintains system integrity and offers convenient future access.
